attempts.retrieval_query: How many days of annual leave do full-time employees get?

retrieval.content: 4.2 Annual Leave. Full-time employees are entitled to 20 days of paid annual leave per calendar year. Leave accrues monthly at a rate of 1.67 days per month of continuous service and may be taken once accrued, subject to manager approval.

Carry-over. Employees may carry over up to 5 days of unused annual leave into the following calendar year. Any unused leave in excess of 5 days is forfeited on December 31 and is not paid out, except where required by local law.
Part-time employees accrue annual leave on a pro-rata basis according to their contracted hours. For example, an employee working 3 days per week accrues 12 days of annual leave per calendar year.
